## Install

```sh
brew install --cask perfect-things/tap/wicher
```

Or download `Wicher-*.dmg` below and drag Wicher to Applications. Wicher is self-signed, not
notarized, so macOS blocks the first launch of a downloaded copy: open it once, then allow it
in **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway** (or run
`xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Wicher.app`). The Homebrew install does this for you.

Apple Silicon, macOS 26 or later. Grant Accessibility when prompted, then press **⌥Tab**.
